visualNotes: Prioritize the 87% diagnostic coverage as the dominant metric.
Keep the diagnostic overview compact and visually distinct.
Render root-cause analysis as a strong horizontal progression.
Give BEFORE and AFTER equal visual weight, using red and neon green only for status contrast.
Keep the six-stage remediation framework secondary to the diagnostic and before-after story.
Use generous negative space and avoid equal-sized boxes everywhere.
Prefer asymmetric composition over a rigid card grid.
Use thin borders, restrained glow, and larger typography instead of excessive ornament.
